# World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)

> WIPO is the United Nations agency for intellectual property, providing global IP services, data, policy resources, and international registration systems.

WIPO supports innovators, creators, businesses, researchers, and governments with international filing systems for patents, trademarks, and designs; global IP databases; legal and policy resources; dispute resolution services; training; and country-focused development programs.

## Organization and Intellectual Property Basics
- [About WIPO](https://www.wipo.int/about-wipo/en/): Overview of WIPO’s mission, governance, leadership, and role in the global IP system.
- [What is Intellectual Property?](https://www.wipo.int/about-ip/en/): Introductory guide to patents, trademarks, copyright, designs, and related IP rights.
- [Inside WIPO](https://www.wipo.int/about-wipo/en/inside_wipo.html): Explains WIPO’s structure, departments, and how the organization operates.
- [Member States](https://www.wipo.int/members/en/): Directory and information about WIPO’s member states and participation.
- [Treaties](https://www.wipo.int/treaties/en/): Gateway to WIPO-administered international IP treaties and legal instruments.
- [News](https://www.wipo.int/news/en/): Official WIPO news, announcements, feature stories, and institutional updates.

## Patents and the PCT System
- [Patents](https://www.wipo.int/patents/en/): Main patents portal covering protection, policy, search, and international filing.
- [Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)](https://www.wipo.int/pct/en/): Central hub for the international patent filing system under the PCT.
- [Protecting Inventions with Patents](https://www.wipo.int/patents/en/protection.html): Practical overview of how patent protection works and when to seek it.
- [PATENTSCOPE](https://patentscope.wipo.int/): Search interface for international patent applications and patent-related data.
- [PCT Applicant’s Guide](https://www.wipo.int/pct/en/guide/): Detailed procedural guidance for applicants using the PCT system.
- [PCT Resources](https://www.wipo.int/pct/en/resources/): Forms, legal texts, fee information, and operational resources for PCT users.
- [Patent Information and Search](https://www.wipo.int/patents/en/patent-information.html): Resources for patent searching, analytics, and technology information.

## Trademarks, Brands, and the Madrid System
- [Trademarks](https://www.wipo.int/trademarks/en/): Main trademarks portal covering brand protection, registration, and policy topics.
- [Madrid System](https://www.wipo.int/madrid/en/): International trademark registration system for managing marks across multiple countries.
- [Protecting Your Brand with Trademarks](https://www.wipo.int/trademarks/en/protection.html): Overview of trademark rights, registration, and brand protection strategy.
- [Madrid Monitor](https://www3.wipo.int/madrid/monitor/en/): Search and track international trademark registrations under the Madrid System.
- [Madrid Goods & Services Manager](https://www.wipo.int/mgs/): Tool for building and validating goods and services lists for trademark filings.
- [Global Brand Database](https://branddb.wipo.int/): Search trademarks, appellations of origin, and official emblems from multiple sources.

## Designs and the Hague System
- [Industrial Designs](https://www.wipo.int/designs/en/): Main portal for design protection, policy, and international registration resources.
- [Hague System](https://www.wipo.int/hague/en/): International registration system for industrial designs across participating jurisdictions.
- [Protecting Designs](https://www.wipo.int/designs/en/protection.html): Explains how industrial design protection works and key filing considerations.
- [Hague Express Database](https://www.wipo.int/hague/en/e-filing.html): Access point for Hague e-filing and related digital services.
- [Global Design Database](https://designdb.wipo.int/): Search industrial design records from WIPO and participating offices.

## Copyright and Creative Industries
- [Copyright](https://www.wipo.int/copyright/en/): Main copyright portal covering legal frameworks, creators’ rights, and policy issues.
- [Copyright and Related Rights](https://www.wipo.int/copyright/en/faq_copyright.html): Frequently asked questions explaining core copyright concepts and exceptions.
- [WIPO Copyright Treaty (WCT)](https://www.wipo.int/treaties/en/ip/wct/): Treaty information for the WIPO Copyright Treaty and related legal materials.
- [WIPO Performances and Phonograms Treaty (WPPT)](https://www.wipo.int/treaties/en/ip/wppt/): Treaty information for performers’ and producers’ related rights.
- [Creative Industries](https://www.wipo.int/copyright/en/creative_industries/): Resources on copyright-based industries and their economic contribution.

## Other IP Rights and Classification Systems
- [Geographical Indications](https://www.wipo.int/geo_indications/en/): Overview of geographical indications, appellations of origin, and protection systems.
- [Traditional Knowledge](https://www.wipo.int/tk/en/): Resources on traditional knowledge, traditional cultural expressions, and genetic resources.
- [Plant Variety Protection](https://www.wipo.int/ip-development/en/agenda/work_undertaken.html): Development-related IP work including areas linked to innovation and policy capacity.
- [International Patent Classification (IPC)](https://www.wipo.int/classifications/ipc/en/): Global patent classification system used for organizing technical subject matter.
- [Nice Classification](https://www.wipo.int/classifications/nice/en/): International classification of goods and services for trademark registration.
- [Locarno Classification](https://www.wipo.int/classifications/locarno/en/): International classification for industrial designs.
- [Vienna Classification](https://www.wipo.int/classifications/vienna/en/): Classification system for figurative elements of trademarks.

## Data, Search, and Global IP Intelligence
- [WIPO IP Portal](https://www.wipo.int/reference/en/): Entry point to WIPO databases, search tools, classifications, and reference resources.
- [WIPO Lex](https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/en/): Global database of IP laws, treaties, and judicial decisions.
- [Global Innovation Index](https://www.wipo.int/global_innovation_index/en/): Benchmarking and analysis of innovation performance across economies.
- [World Intellectual Property Indicators](https://www.wipo.int/ipstats/en/wipi/): Annual statistics on global patent, trademark, design, and other IP activity.
- [IP Statistics Data Center](https://www.wipo.int/ipstats/en/): Interactive statistical data on IP filings, grants, and international systems.
- [Technology Trends](https://www.wipo.int/tech_trends/en/): Reports analyzing emerging technologies through patent and innovation data.
- [WIPO Pearl](https://pearl.wipo.int/): Multilingual terminology database for scientific and technical concepts.

## Dispute Resolution and Domain Name Services
- [WIPO Arbitration and Mediation Center](https://www.wipo.int/amc/en/): Alternative dispute resolution services for IP, technology, and commercial disputes.
- [Domain Name Disputes](https://www.wipo.int/amc/en/domains/): UDRP and related procedures for resolving internet domain name disputes.
- [Mediation](https://www.wipo.int/amc/en/mediation/): Mediation services tailored to IP and technology-related conflicts.
- [Arbitration](https://www.wipo.int/amc/en/arbitration/): Arbitration and expedited arbitration options for private dispute resolution.
- [Good Offices](https://www.wipo.int/amc/en/goodoffices/): Informal assistance for parties seeking settlement in IP-related disputes.

## Learning, Training, and Capacity Building
- [WIPO Academy](https://www.wipo.int/academy/en/): Training, courses, degrees, and professional development in intellectual property.
- [Distance Learning](https://www.wipo.int/academy/en/courses/distance_learning/): Online IP courses for beginners, practitioners, and public-sector professionals.
- [IP for Youth and Educators](https://www.wipo.int/academy/en/): Educational resources and learning pathways for students and teachers.
- [Judicial Institute](https://www.wipo.int/judicial/en/): Resources and programs supporting judges and judicial systems on IP matters.
- [WIPO Knowledge Center](https://www.wipo.int/reference/en/): Reference materials, glossaries, and research tools for IP learning.

## Development, Country Support, and SMEs
- [Development Agenda](https://www.wipo.int/ip-development/en/agenda/): WIPO’s framework for integrating development considerations into IP work.
- [IP and Innovation Ecosystems](https://www.wipo.int/ip-development/en/): Programs supporting national IP systems, innovation, and economic development.
- [SMEs and Entrepreneurship](https://www.wipo.int/sme/en/): Practical IP guidance for small and medium-sized enterprises and startups.
- [WIPO GREEN](https://www.wipo.int/green/en/): Platform connecting sustainable technology needs with green innovation solutions.
- [WIPO Re:Search](https://www.wipo.int/research/en/): Consortium advancing research on neglected tropical diseases, malaria, and tuberculosis.
- [Country Profiles](https://www.wipo.int/members/en/): Country-focused access to membership and participation in WIPO systems.

## Publications, Reports, and Media
- [Publications](https://www.wipo.int/publications/en/): Official reports, guides, magazines, and reference publications from WIPO.
- [WIPO Magazine](https://www.wipo.int/wipo_magazine/en/): Feature articles and interviews on innovation, creativity, and IP worldwide.
- [World IP Report](https://www.wipo.int/web-publications/world-intellectual-property-report-2024/en/): In-depth analysis of technology, innovation, and IP trends.
- [Economic Research](https://www.wipo.int/econ_stat/en/economics/): Research on the economics of innovation, creativity, and intellectual property.
- [Press Releases](https://www.wipo.int/pressroom/en/): Official media announcements and institutional communications.
- [Events](https://www.wipo.int/meetings/en/): Conferences, assemblies, webinars, and meetings organized by WIPO.
